title: Chapter 621
paragraphs: Chapter 621
Episode 159. The King's Tournament (8)
"Do as you please."
Vahn responded in a calm voice.
The ones surprised by his response were not Jin, but rather the Myeongwang Clan.
The Myeongwang Clan had been hoping for Vahn to intervene in this terribly escalating situation.
Since Jin first stabbed Kaio, no, since the first time Garmund and Kaio had argued, they had hoped so.
However, Vahn never intervened in the brothers' disputes, even at this critical point.
They couldn't understand. Whether he was disappointed in Jin, disappointed in them, or there was some other reason, they didn't know.
If he had favored Jin, the Myeongwang Clan would have followed without question.

Even if Vahn had punished the brothers who dared to demand a new test from his chosen successor, they would have accepted it, and even if he told them to consider Jin's words as their own, they would have obeyed.

'Why are you just watching until the end...... Is it because of the guilt of the final war? Because you think that the extinction of the race at that time was due to the decision of the fighting brothers, are you now choosing not to choose anything? Even though the brothers are in such a state of division!'
Vahn briefly looked into Baba's eyes. Baba felt as if her inner feelings were completely exposed, she felt ashamed as if she was being petulant, but she didn't avoid his gaze.
"If you can, that is."
At Vahn's following words, Baba's pupils widened.
After being stunned for a few seconds, she gritted her teeth as if they might break.
"......Understood."
As Vahn and Lingling flew off somewhere, Jin turned around for a moment and looked at Baba and the Myeongwang Clan.
"You're very kind. Kaio, and you too."
"What did you say?"
"You say you'll take my eyes, you'll kill me. Do you really need to tell me that in advance? If you're confident, don't talk, just do it. That kind of behavior only makes you look weak."
Baba slowly nodded her head.
"Advice, well received."
The fight between Jin and Baba is the 65th Tournament.
The revived tradition of hope for liberation is now reaching its climax, like the relationship between Jin and the Myeongwang Clan.
There were several more tournaments after the 65th, but the Myeongwang Clan considered the fight between the two to be the last of the King's Tournament.
Until the start of that fight, the other tournaments couldn't hold much meaning for the Myeongwang Clan.
Jin's death is directly connected to the fate of Lafrarosa.
The guilt of being the leader when the race faced extinction.
The Myeongwang Clan, guessing that this is why Vahn has not intervened so far, were not just Baba.
Most of the Myeongwang Clan had similar thoughts.
"If the Brother Kings kill Jin... our time will probably stop forever. Perhaps the next successor of the Holy Sword will not come."

"We were already extinct anyway. No, definitely. Thanks to Solderlet, we are merely surviving in a dead world. Jin became a brother and showed us hope, but eventually, he turned his back on us over minor conflicts. He wasn't a brother from the start."

"Yes, from the start... When the Brother Kings transfused blood and asked us for our opinion, we should have opposed. Then we would have simply passed on the Holy Sword to him, and we wouldn't have been betrayed......"
Betrayal.
The Myeongwang Clan understood Jin's actions up to this point in that way. He couldn't do this much just because a few people asked for additional verification.
"Anyway, it doesn't feel real. The fact that tonight might be our real end......"
Among the dejected Myeongwang Clan, Baba had a determined look in her eyes.
Time passed cruelly fast. The Myeongwang Clan ascended to the main hall with sullen and angry faces.
Unlike usual, the sky in the main hall was just dark.
The Myeongwang Clan, as if promised, had calmed the thunderstorm they usually released whenever a tournament was held.
Kaio, who had been sick in bed since the 22nd tournament, also ascended to the main hall, carried by Baba.
"Before starting the 65th Tournament, I want to tell the brothers something."
At Vahn's words, the pupils of the Myeongwang Clan grew larger.
'No way.'
'Are the Brother Kings going to intervene now......!?'
However, Baba's pupils were not shaken at all then.
She had already made up her mind.
And the words Vahn spoke next were far beyond everyone's expectation.
"Even if Baba kills Jin in this tournament, Lafrarosa's time will not completely stop. Perhaps because it was originally Jin's chaos. Lingling, this child can play the same role as Jin."
"That, is that... really true, Brother Kings? Lingling can play the same role as Jin."
[It's true!]
"Yes. I've been feeling it since I accepted Lingling, but it was confirmed two days ago."
He didn't add a detailed explanation of how that was possible, or how he had confirmed it.
Nevertheless, everyone could clearly recognize it. That Vahn's words were true.
'So, even if Jin dies, our time won't completely end...!'
'As Lingling is the first chaos, it might even be more than possible. The Brother Kings say it with such certainty.'
The fate of Lafrarosa, which was solely dependent on Jin, now has a new alternative called Lingling.
A heavy silence passed. Except for Vahn, only Baba maintained complete tranquility within it.
Baba handed Kaio to Garumunde.
Garumunde scratched the back of his head and adjusted his posture to make Kaio feel as comfortable as possible.
"I'll be back."
Baba slowly moved towards the center of the main hall. Behind her stood 11 Touwang and 64 members of the Myeongwang Clan.
There was nobody standing behind Jin approaching from the opposite side.
"Start the 65th Tournament."
Even though the tournament started, Jin and Baba didn't draw their swords for a while.
But the fighting spirit flowing from the two was already weighing down the entire main hall.
'Only about ten days have passed, but in that time, not only has he recovered his body... he's become stronger.'
The energy flowing from Jin was unusual. Jin, as he was now, and when he lost to Lumora in the 54th tournament, seemed like completely different people.
"It's okay to kill, if you can. I was curious why the Brother Kings said that to me."
"Do you understand now?"
"A little. And there was one more thing I was curious about. Why are you doing this......"
Swoosh......
Baba's sword, 'Light,' slowly emerged from its sheath.
Light was the sword used by Nana, her ancestor and the previous Tou Shin. As the name suggests, a dazzling light was clinging to the blade.
"It was a trivial issue. This verification was neither an excessive demand nor the wish of everyone. But you turned your back on your brothers just because of that."
Jin also slowly drew his sword. The pale blade of Sigmund contrasted with the Light.

"I thought we would be anxious. We, who have always given absolute support, must have looked like we revealed our greed as soon as the situation changed in your eyes. It must have been completely unexpected for you."

"It's funny. It's not even certainty, but as soon as the hope of getting out arose, you revealed your true intentions. So I provoked a bit, and in no time, most of you united to say that you should take this sword away from me. You even talked about exile."
"A bit? A bit, you say?"

"That's the essence of what you call brotherhood. Just a few words divide the sides, and you exile me, who has already been acknowledged as a brother and inherited the sword by the choice of Tou Shin. You say it's an accident and threaten me. I felt disillusioned by your actions."
"Did you not think of talking before stabbing Kaio? No, even after you stabbed him."

"When I found out that there is more than one brother, what conversation is needed? Is it okay to overlook Kaio's actions, who threatened me with an accident even though more effective suppression was possible, because he's a brother, and my stabbing of Kaio is not okay because he's not a brother?"
"Kaio didn't shoot you in the end. And doing something and not doing it are never the same. You tried to kill your brother..."
"I almost lost my eyes, or my head, but it's fine because Kaio didn't shoot me in the end. Then, I did stab Kaio, but he didn't die. No one died."
"Moreover, the intention of Kaio's pressure on you..."
"Then, couldn't I also have another intention? Was it impossible to think that I had a reason to stab Kaio?"
"Belriz, Garumunde, Linpa, and the flat warriors visited your sickroom to ask that."
"That's right. They were the only ones who came to see me, and they blamed me. Did the majority of the Myeongwang clan on the other side do the same to Kaio?"
Baba couldn't answer.
"You don't know the essence of the problem at all. It's just that your true intentions are revealed when an opportunity arises. Kaio is a brother, and I was just a close outsider."
"......You're nitpicking. So, you're trying to justify stabbing your brother because you're upset? There's a limit."
"It's a difference in standards. If you want to prove that you're right, stop talking and stretch out your sword. Now that Lingling is here, there's no reason to hesitate in dealing with me."
Baba's eyes grew cold.
"Lingling... Whether we can go outside or not is not the important issue. I hope you didn't think that the reason we've been looking out for you all this time was because of that."
Shzzzzz...!
As Baba began to gather energy, the entire main hall was instantly engulfed in a dark thunderstorm.
"I will show you why the brothers think I'm the one who should inherit Tou Shin."
Myeongwang Sword, Gutouwang Jeolgi
Punishment
Baba rushed towards Jin like a blue spear, and Jin faced her head-on, swinging Sigmund.
'This damned villain role is finally coming to an end.'
He thought so while doing it.
